name: Shield Bearer (Warpriest Archetype)
body:
The shield bearer is like a rock in the river of battle, standing strong as the water breaks around it. They hold their shield as a divine bulwark defending them and sending their foes scattering in the face of its might.

Shield of the Divine (Ex)

At 1st level, the shield bearer gains a +1 bonus to their shield’s AC and a DR 1/- when wielding a shield and not flat-footed. At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter the bonus to shield’s AC and the DR increases by 1.

The bonuses stack with bonuses provided by other feats. This ability replaces weapons of the faithful however, this ability may still work with other archetypes that replace weapons of the faithful. In those circumstances, this ability is replaced.

Shield Channel (Su)

Beginning at 1st level, instead of healing or harming all creatures within a radius with their fervor, instead they heal or harm all creatures within a 60-foot cone using their shield. This ability modifies fervor but does not prevent the ability from being replaced by other archetypes.
